privacy: PRIVACY POLICY
Welcome to Hallelujah Challenge (the “Platform”). We take the issue of data protection and privacy seriously, ensuring that our community’s privacy is adequately guaranteed and protected.

This Privacy Policy describes our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the information we collect from and about you when you use our Service and the choices you have associated with that data. By visiting and using this Platform, you expressly consent to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information in accordance with this Privacy Policy. This Privacy Policy is incorporated into and subject to our Terms and Conditions.
IF YOU DO NOT AGREE TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY, PLEASE DO NOT USE THE PLATFORM.
1. INFORMATION COLLECTION AND USE

We collect a variety of information to provide and improve our Services. We process your information when necessary to fulfill our contract with you, where we have your prior consent, or where we have a legitimate interest (such as security, analytics, and reporting).
1.1. Personal Information You Provide Directly
Contact & Profile Information: First name, last name, phone number, postal address, email address, and profile photo.

Identity Information: For verification and security, we may request an image of your government-issued ID (International Passport, National ID, or Driver’s License) and a "selfie" to confirm identity.
Testimonies & Content: We collect the content of any testimony, prayer request, or message you post on our community forums or social media integrations.
Support & Communications: Call recordings, chat transcripts, and emails collected during customer support interactions to investigate and respond to concerns.
1.2. Information Automatically Collected
Usage Data: IP address, browser type, hardware and software versions, device event information (crashes), and read receipts.
Geolocation Data: Determined from your IP address or mobile GPS, depending on your device settings and permissions.
Tracking & Cookies: We use cookies and similar technologies to track activity and maintain certain data for analysis and valuable improvement of our Service.
1.3. Payment & Transaction Information
To process registrations, donations, or merchandise purchases, we collect payment account details and transaction history.
Note: We utilize third-party payment processing companies. These service providers, and not us, store your full credit card/bank information and are solely responsible for its security.
2. LEGAL BASIS FOR PROCESSING
In accordance with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) 2023, our legal basis for processing is as follows:
Consent: Where you have given clear consent for us to process your data for a specific purpose (e.g., newsletter or testimonies).
Legal Obligation: Where we must comply with Nigerian or international law.
Legitimate Interests: For the enforcement of our terms, fraud prevention, and to safeguard the Hallelujah Challenge community.
3. THIRD-PARTY PARTNERS & INTEGRATIONS
We only share information with your consent, to comply with laws, to provide you with services, or to protect your rights. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
Service Providers: We may share data with third-party vendors (e.g., email marketing services) who perform services for us.
Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information where we are legally required to do so to comply with applicable law, governmental requests, or a judicial proceeding.
4. DATA TRANSFER & STORAGE
Your information, including Personal Data, may be transferred to—and maintained on—computers located outside of Nigeria, where data protection laws may differ.

International Transfers: If we transfer data to partners outside Nigeria, we ensure adequate controls are in place to protect your information in accordance with this policy and the requirements of applicable law.
Retention: We will only keep your information for as long as necessary for the purposes set out in this policy, unless a longer period is required by law.
5. SECURITY OF DATA

While no organization can guarantee perfect security, we implement and update administrative, technical, and physical security measures (such as encryption and firewalls) to prevent unauthorized access, loss, or alteration. You are responsible for the security of your own account passwords.
6. YOUR PRIVACY RIGHTS
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
1. Access & Rectification: Request a copy of your data or correct inaccurate information.
2. Erasure (Right to be Forgotten): Request that we delete your personal data.
3. Data Portability: Request a transfer of your data to another entity.
4. Withdraw Consent: At any time, we rely on your consent to process data.
5. Lodge a Complaint: With the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC).
To exercise these rights, contact our Data Protection Officer at [Insert Email Address].
7. CHILDREN’S PRIVACY

Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 18 (“Children”). We do not knowingly collect information from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child without parental consent, we will take immediate steps to remove that information from our servers.
8. CONTACT US
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, don't hesitate to get in touch with us:
By Email: info@hallelujahchallengelive.com

cookies: COOKIES POLICY

This Cookies and Similar Technologies Policy (this “Policy”) provides you with general information about cookies and similar technologies (collectively, “Tracking Technologies”) as well as how and for what purposes Hallelujah Challenge (“we”, “us” or “our”) uses such Tracking Technologies on our platform.

To ensure you have a customized and seamless spiritual experience on our Site, we use cookies to understand how you interact with our content. This Policy explains what these technologies are and how you can control them. For any questions, please contact us at [Insert Support Email].
1. WHAT IS A COOKIE?

Cookies are small data files stored on your browser or device. They allow us to recognize your device and "remember" certain information (like your login status or preferences) to improve your experience. We also use web beacons, tags, and scripts to analyze our Service and monitor the effectiveness of our ministry communications.
2. TYPES OF COOKIES WE USE
2.1. Strictly Necessary Cookies

These are essential for the Platform to function. They enable secure logins, protect against fraudulent activity, and allow you to access the core features of the Hallelujah Challenge. Without these, the site cannot perform as intended.
2.2. Functional Cookies (Preference Cookies)
These cookies remember your settings, such as your preferred language, region, or customized dashboard settings. While you can block these, your preferences will be lost each time you visit.
2.3. Analytics and Performance Cookies
These help us measure how users interact with our site (e.g., which pages are visited most during a live session). We use these to improve our technical performance and user interface.
• Google Analytics: We use this to track traffic and monitor site usage. This data is shared with Google to help us contextualize our reach. Google’s Privacy & Terms.
2.4. Advertising and Profiling Cookies

These cookies track your browsing behavior to help us segment our community and deliver relevant ministry updates or event information. They help us understand which users engage with certain sessions to better tailor our future content and marketing strategies.
3. THIRD-PARTY ANALYTICS

We may use third-party Service Providers to monitor and analyze the use of our Service. For example, if you receive an email from us, we may use analytics tools to see if the message was opened or if specific links were clicked. This helps us gauge the effectiveness of our outreach.
4. COMBINED AND AGGREGATED DATA

We may combine information collected through Tracking Technologies with information from other sources (online or offline) to improve our services. Additionally, we may use Aggregate/De-Identified Data (data that can no longer be linked to you personally) for research, reporting, or sharing with partners and sponsors to show the impact of the Hallelujah Challenge.
5. YOUR CHOICES: HOW TO CONTROL COOKIES
You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies.
• Browser Settings: Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can usually modify your settings to decline them. Consult your browser’s “Help” function for instructions.
• Cookie Banner: You can manage your preferences directly through the cookie consent banner that appears when you first visit our site.
• Mobile Devices: Your mobile device may allow you to control cookies through its settings function.
Note: If you choose to decline or delete cookies, some portions of the Hallelujah Challenge Platform may not function properly, and you may lose access to certain personalized features.
6. CONTACT US
If you have any questions or comments about our use of Tracking Technologies, please reach out to us:
• Email: info@hallelujahchallengelive.com
